qa.question: Should Hopkins be entered as the county for KYMEA Energy Center I?
qa.finding: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) gives Hopkins County. The air permit (https://dep.gateway.ky.gov/eSearch.WebApi/api/documentGenerate/getDocument/13751619) gives the address 1757 AC Slaton Road, Madisonville, and the commission order (https://psc.ky.gov/pscscf/2024%20Cases/2024-00290//20250402_PSC_ORDER.pdf) names Hopkins County.
qa.recommendation: Enter Hopkins in the Local area field, with the EIA table and the commission order as sources.
qa.note: The current point is already marked exact and was not reopened.

qa.question: Is MISO queue row S1073 the interconnection request for KYMEA Energy Center I?
qa.finding: Row S1073 is 75 MW with no fuel shown, queued February 19, 2025, at the Hopkins to Reid 161 kV line owned by Big Rivers, with Webster County listed. The size and the Big Rivers connection fit the plant. The queue does not name KYMEA, and the KYMEA page says its switching station was transferred to LG&E and KU, whose area EIA lists as the balancing authority.
qa.recommendation: Treat S1073 as a probable match but do not cite it for any value. Ask KYMEA or check the interconnection agreement if a firm link is needed.
qa.note: I read the MISO project list file on November 5, 2026. Row J3089 is a withdrawn 696 MW Reid combined cycle and is unrelated. The queue page itself is a lead and was not run through the verifier.

qa.question: Is Kentucky Municipal Power Agency the same company as Kentucky Municipal Energy Agency?
qa.finding: GEM spells the owner Kentucky Municipal Power Agency. EIA, the air permit and the commission case all say Kentucky Municipal Energy Agency, and the KYMEA website uses KYMEA.
qa.recommendation: Leave the owner as is, or rename the entity to the spelling EIA and the commission use if the entity record allows it.
qa.note: No owner change is proposed, so the entity lookup was not needed.

qa.question: Does the 2023 IRP of KYMEA differ from GEM for Energy Center I?
qa.finding: The KYMEA 2023 integrated resource plan at https://s3.amazonaws.com/kymea-twill/4031257f-39bb-4be9-99b8-87cfeaf6cff8/2025_06_IRP2023-Report-Draft-v.24_6_05_25.pdf says the 75 MW Energy Center I, four Wartsila engines in Hopkins County, is expected to reach commercial operation by June 2027. This matches GEM's capacity and start year.
qa.recommendation: Leave GEM as is and add an integrated resource plan note that the 2023 plan lists Energy Center I and no other new gas.
qa.note: The plan was read in full text on November 5, 2026. It is the draft dated June 2025 that the board approved in January 2025 per the resources page at https://www.kymea.org/irp/irp-resources/.
